name: hcapp_getChatPhotoUploadToken
description: Authenticates a request to upload one chat photo (E9.F1.S11). Called by the API function GetChatPhotoUploadToken, which then signs a 15-minute, write-only SAS for chat-photos/<yyyy>/<MM>/<userId>-<photoGuid>.jpg using the userId returned here. The path carries the uploader's id from the token, never from the request, so a hasher can only write under their own name. Posting the photo to a chat is a separate act gated by the send SPs. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 124, @param NULL). No DB writes on success.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device. Default NULL (a NULL is refused by ValidateAppAuth as 'Device not registered').

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token (standard, device secret). Default NULL.

parameters.name: photoGuid
parameters.description: Client-chosen GUID that names the blob. Default NULL; NULL or the zero UUID is refused with errorCode 1984 / errorType 2 (logged). Not stored by this SP — the API uses it to build the blob path.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always rowset 0. { success = 1, errorCode NULL, errorType NULL } on success; { success = 0, errorCode, errorType } on auth failure (codes from ValidateAppAuth) or missing photoGuid (1984 / 2).

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: NULL on success. 1984 = missing photoGuid; 1124 / 1224 / 1324 from ValidateAppAuth (bad token / signed out / device not registered).

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: NULL on success. 2 = validation; 1 / 7 / 3 from ValidateAppAuth.

columns.name: userId
columns.description: The token's user (HC.Device.UserId) — becomes the uploader segment of the blob path.

rowsets.description: On failure, after the success = 0 envelope.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog on missing photoGuid (line 52) and, with THROW, on an unhandled error (line 69). Nothing is written on success.
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
